summary: Huachen AI Parking Management Technology Holding Co., Ltd filed a routine Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, containing its unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements and related disclosures for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing covers ordinary-course items: share capital structure across Class A and Class B shares, the February 2025 IPO and April 2026 follow-on issuance, lease commitments, customer and supplier concentration, related-party balances with Chenjie Hong and Guowei Xie, and Zhejiang TD Parking. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are stated. No risk-arb angle applies.
